about: Our start quest and the holding cell it moves the player to (decision 0012 §1). The cell joins Claywater's block when 0.4 §d builds it; 3.3 replaces the hold with the opening.

studio.why: the studio character of decision 0022, fixed answers (3.2 later builds it through its own flow); scenes may name any other

player.why: the Player NPC_ (Skyrim.esm 0x7) starts every new game as ArgonianRace with the race's own preset face: its head parts (the race defaults, the preset's eyes, brows, scars and horn/frill set), feather colour, morphs and tints (dark green scales, black frills); the race's default face texture so the head's scales match the body's; no console setrace (1.10). The engine builds the player's face at run time; no FaceGen is shipped (0014)
player.kitWhy: the starting kit (owner look 1, 1.12): a sword, a mace, a scimitar, a hunting bow and arrows, the Imperial light set (the steel helmet's horns read Nordic) and 5,000 gold to try the shops (owner play test 3, finding 34), in place of the master Player's items; every piece wears its base-game record's look (items_records.look)
